name: CiteLaw
description:
A full legal research and firm management toolset, inside Claude

Connect Claude to CiteLaw's U.S. legal database: 9.4M+ court opinions, 1.95M+ statutes, regulations, and court rules, plus standing orders, agency decisions, Tax Court opinions, and 485K+ law journal articles. Claude answers using CiteLaw's live, current text instead of relying on memory, so citations are more accurate and grounded in the real authority.

Legal Research:
Ask a legal question in plain English and Claude searches cases, statutes, and rules across jurisdictions, or run precise Boolean and keyword queries. Pull the full text of any opinion, statute, or rule by ID, not just a snippet. Check whether a case is still good law by finding later decisions that cite it and how they treat it. Paste in a brief or citation list and Claude verifies each authority exists and catches bad or mismatched cites before you file. Search your own uploaded documents and past research sessions right alongside the case law.

Firm management:
Run conflict checks against existing clients, opposing parties, and matters before taking on new work. Track prospective clients through your intake pipeline, and manage a shared contact book linked directly to matters. Create and track discovery sets and requests for the current matter. Pull from a firm-wide clause library instead of redrafting contracts and letters from scratch. Manage deadlines and assignable tasks in one place, and save research sessions, notes, and drafted documents (as Word files) to your matter. Matters and workspaces are shared, so what your team adds is accessible right from Claude.

Built for attorneys, law students, and legal scholars. CiteLaw retrieves and explains the law; it is a research tool, not legal advice, and using it does not create an attorney-client relationship.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CiteLaw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CiteLaw to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://citelaw.org/api/mcp/protocol. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CiteLaw MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CiteLaw lists 36 MCP tools, including authority_lookup, authority_search_metadata, check_case_treatment, check_corpus_coverage, create_document, create_note, extract_citations, get_active_context, judge_lookup, list_matters, list_workspaces, and query_notes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CiteLaw?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CiteLaw in legal on the Manufact MCP catalog include GVRN Company Incorporation MCP, Alizé, Ansvar AI, Casepoint, and CookieYes.
CiteLaw requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CiteLaw is developed by CiteLaw. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
